display_name: Residence and sources of income: Income Tax Ordinance s 1 (Israeli resident, foreign resident, tax year), s 2(2)(b), s 2A and s 14(b), with the deemed-residents Regulations of 5766-2006 and the vehicle and mobile telephone value Regulations

language.note: English identifiers (@lang en); the Hebrew of every provision is quoted in `-- src:TAG:N |` comments generated mechanically from the deposited sources by tools/srcquote.py and checked line by line by tools/hebcheck.py (run by check.sh).

scope: Encoded: ITO s 1 'Israeli resident' (a) (the centre of life as a finding or five ties, the day-count presumptions (183 days; 30 days and 425 over three tax years; a part of a day is a day), their rebuttal, the Minister's power) with the Regulations of 5766-2006 regs 2 and 3, and (b) a body of persons with its exception; s 1 'foreign resident' with its second limb; s 1 'tax year'; s 2(2)(b) with the vehicle Regulations of 5747-1987, the temporary provision of 5776-2015 and the mobile telephone Regulations of 5762-2002; s 2A; s 14(b) and the definition of a veteran returning resident in s 14(a); the territorial charge of s 2 on both statuses. Taken as inputs: the finding of the centre of life, the prices, indices, exchange rates and the weighted price of 2010 for the vehicle value, the Minister's determinations under s 2A(b)(3). Not encoded: s 2's other sources (IL-08), the exemption of s 14(a), the other periods of s 14(b)(2), the Vehicle Expenses Deduction Regulations of 5755-1995 (needs a source). Sixteen forks are switches, by default declining by name where the readings differ (Meng's ruling SHRUG of 2026-10-08).
years_answered: tax years from 2024 (assumption A1, as row IL-08); the published caps and reductions only for the years their notes print (2024 to 2026; the telephone ceiling 2023 to 2027); other years refused 'needs a source'

inputs.published_figures: ito-il29-published-figures.l4: the adjusted cap on the consumer price (563,790 / 583,100 / 596,860 for 2024 / 2025 / 2026), the L3 motorcycle amount (1,010 / 1,040 / 1,070), the telephone ceiling (NIS 115 for 2023 to 2027), and the reductions of the temporary provision (540 for (b1) in 2024; 580, 1,150, 1,380 for (c1), (d1), (d2) in 2026), each from a Wikisource editorial note on the deposited file, with its source line; NOT LAW

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source, and no independent test pass has been run yet. Every expected value in the tests was worked by hand from the Hebrew before the code was run.

forks.C1: Ties that all lie one way and no finding: do they find the centre of life? A: no (a weighing of the whole); B: yes. Default declined.
forks.C2: A presumption arose and was rebutted, no finding: is the centre of life abroad? A: the text does not say; B: yes. Default declined.
forks.W: How a window of time that runs from a day is matched with a tax year it begins or ends inside: whole / some day / last day / count of tax years. Default declined where they differ.
forks.N90: Within 90 days of arrival: is the 90th day after it in time? A: yes; B: no (arrival day is day 1). Default declined at day 90 only.
forks.F5Y: Reg 3: foreign resident in every one of the five preceding tax years, or at least one? Default declined where mixed.
forks.JA: Reg 3(8): must a foreign journalist or athlete (defined in s 75A as a foreign resident) not already be an Israeli resident? Default declined.
forks.YD: Second limb of foreign resident: deems the first tax year of the pair, or both? Default declined where they differ.
forks.PD: Second limb: is a day partly outside Israel a day outside? Default declined where the sum crosses 183.
forks.BS: A person who is both an Israeli and a foreign resident: which status does the charge of s 2 read? Default answers for income produced in Israel, declines for income from abroad.
forks.PY: A body with control and management in Israel for part of the tax year: resident? Default declined.
forks.MP: Rounding to ten shekels at an exact midpoint: up or down? Default declined at a midpoint.
forks.XD: A reduction or payment larger than the monthly value: nil or negative? Default declined where it occurs.
forks.SCH: VTP (b1) reduces the amounts of a repealed Schedule: is the reduction taken from reg 2(a)'s value, or none, for a hybrid registered before 2010? Default declined.
forks.DEP: The use depreciation of a personally imported vehicle is 1% a month of what: the sum, or the customs value? Default declined.
forks.PMD: A part of a month of use depreciation: counts or not? Default declined.
forks.PM: A part of a month of use of a vehicle or telephone: a month, prorated, or nothing? Default declined.
